projects.title: EcoQuest
projects.description: A published Unity mobile game built around procedural level generation and environmental gameplay. As sole developer I designed the procedural system that generates unique levels on each run, built the core gameplay loop and UI, and optimized the build for low-end Android devices to keep load times short and frame rates stable.

projectDetails.Challenge: Generate varied, balanced levels at runtime without hand-authoring each one
projectDetails.Outcome: Shipped a replayable mobile game with procedurally generated levels optimized for low-end Android

projects.title: VR Plane Marshalling Trainer
projects.description: An enterprise VR trainer that teaches aircraft marshalling signals and ramp procedures using realistic hand-gesture interactions on Oculus Quest. I built the gesture-recognition and signal-validation logic, the guided training flow with real-time feedback, and tuned rendering to hold a stable 90 FPS on standalone Quest hardware.

projectDetails.Tech: Unity, OpenXR, Oculus SDK, hand-gesture interaction
projectDetails.Challenge: Accurately recognize and validate standardized marshalling signals in VR
projectDetails.Outcome: Delivered a hands-on Quest trainer running at a stable 90 FPS with real-time signal feedback

projects.title: Wardrobe Management VR
projects.description: A VR application that lets users organize clothing items inside a virtual wardrobe through intuitive grab-and-place hand interactions. I implemented the physics-based grab system, the categorization and outfit-assembly UI in 3D space, and persistence so a user's arranged wardrobe is saved between sessions.

projectDetails.Challenge: Make grabbing, sorting and placing many items in 3D feel natural and reliable
projectDetails.Outcome: Built an interactive virtual wardrobe with saved layouts and smooth hand interactions

projects.title: Warehouse Management VR Simulator
projects.description: An enterprise VR simulator that trains staff on warehouse operations and logistics workflows — picking, scanning, stacking and safe handling. I built the interactive task system with step-by-step scoring, the multiplayer-ready scene structure, and applied GPU instancing and occlusion culling to keep the dense warehouse environment performant in VR.

projectDetails.Tech: Unity, OpenXR, GPU instancing, occlusion culling
projectDetails.Challenge: Keep a large, asset-dense warehouse scene running smoothly on VR hardware
projectDetails.Outcome: Shipped a scored, task-based warehouse trainer with optimized rendering for standalone VR

projects.title: Workers Posture Correction System
projects.description: A VR training system that tracks a worker's body posture and gives real-time guidance to correct improper lifting and working positions, reducing injury risk. I built the joint-tracking and posture-analysis logic, the live visual cues that flag unsafe positions, and a session report that summarizes posture quality over a training run.

projectDetails.Challenge: Analyze posture from VR tracking data and give clear, real-time corrective feedback
projectDetails.Outcome: Delivered a posture-coaching VR trainer with live cues and per-session reporting
